value.rationale: Complete natural graph characterization, not a single small numerical example: a temporal observation channel can turn strong social copying into exactly independent apparent personal inertia iff there are no shared-neighbor motifs. With branching, strictly positive common-parent covariance provides a universal diagnostic for each initial condition, making a precise network design and sampling-identifiability boundary. The result is relevant to empirical disagreement between social influence and memory and distinguishes an exact observational law from heuristic correlation fits.
